CommunityApplications.Profile:
MMC (Media Meta Cleaner) removes embedded metadata from video files so media servers like Plex and Jellyfin rely solely on filenames.
This repository publishes the Unraid Community Apps template for the MMC container image (galvatrondeva/mmc-media-meta-cleaner). The image is a web application - Node.js backend with a modern React UI and a Python media worker - that scans directories for video files (.mkv, .mp4, .avi, .mov, .wmv, .flv), probes them for metadata tags (title, subtitle, tags, keywords, comment, description, synopsis), and provides a checkbox interface to selectively remove metadata.
Features: Fast (In-Place) and Safe (Copy) processing modes, real-time progress, post-processing verification, pause/resume/cancel, in-app logs, dark/light themes.
For issues and feature requests, open an issue at https://github.com/Phive-5/mmc-media-meta-cleaner/issues.
